ruleDefinitions.name: RDP Sensitive Settings Changed
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects tampering of RDP Terminal Service/Server sensitive settings.
Such as allowing unauthorized users access to a system via the 'fAllowUnsolicited' or enabling RDP via 'fDenyTSConnections'...etc
 Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\Terminal\\ Services\\\\.*")) AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Shadow$") AND (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000003\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000004\)")) OR ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\Terminal\\ Services\\\\.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableRemoteDesktopAntiAlias$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\DisableSecuritySettings$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\fAllowUnsolicited$") OR registry_path = RGX("\\\\fAllowUnsolicitedFullControl$")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)") OR (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\InitialProgram.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Control\\\\Terminal\\ Server\\\\WinStations\\\\RDP\\-Tcp\\\\InitialProgram.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\services\\\\TermService\\\\Parameters\\\\ServiceDll.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\Terminal\\ Services\\\\InitialProgram.*"))
